terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: These terms govern your access to and use of RATQ Community Platform, APIs, and published assets.
terms.p2: All developers and publishers agree to uphold intellectual property rights, stated license agreements, and sacred text guardrails.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy.p1: We are dedicated to safeguarding your privacy in compliance with applicable standards including GDPR and Saudi Personal Data Protection Law.
privacy.p2: We never sell your personal data. We collect only the minimum required to authenticate accounts and fulfill requested services.

dmca.title: Copyright & DMCA Notice Policy
dmca.instructions: To file a copyright infringement notice, provide details of the copyrighted work, URL of the infringing item, and a good-faith statement.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.standard: RATQ is committed to WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance, providing an accessible experience for screen readers and keyboard navigation.
